/*orion:meta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.name AS league_name,aliases.keys AS league_keys,
 totals.matches_count AS match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version
 AND ($1::bigint IS NOT NULL OR p.published_to_gen IS NULL) LIMIT 1) published ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key) keys FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=e.competition_id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.status='ready' AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR b.id=$1::bigint)
ORDER BY e.season_key DESC,b.competition_season_id,b.id LIMIT 2049

/*orion:appearance:publicationmeta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.competition_season_revision_id::text edition_revision_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.id::text competition_id,co.name AS league_name,
 co.image_asset_id::text competition_asset_id,country.iso2 AS country,
 aliases.keys AS league_keys,totals.matches_count::text match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'

sql.sql:
/*orion:appearance:publicationmeta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.competition_season_revision_id::text edition_revision_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.id::text competition_id,co.name AS league_name,
 co.image_asset_id::text competition_asset_id,country.iso2 AS country,
 aliases.keys AS league_keys,totals.matches_count::text match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version LIMIT 1) publication ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id
 AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN football.countries country ON country.id=co.country_id AND country.revision_id=co.country_revision_id
 AND country.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (country.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<country.recorded_to_gen) AND country.is_canonical AND NOT country.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key COLLATE "C") keys
 FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=co.id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.id=$1::bigint AND b.status='ready' LIMIT 2

/*orion:appearance:admissionmeta*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS c(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,edition_revision_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,competition_id bigint)),
matches AS (
 SELECT s.*,x.dg,x.cg,aliases.public_id
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
 AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), sides AS (
 SELECT mt.*,m.dg,m.cg,aliases.public_id AS team_public_id FROM matches m
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=m.match_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=mt.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), performances AS (
 SELECT s.*,m.dg,m.cg,m.public_id AS match_public_id,m.match_date,
 mp.profile_version_id,mp.is_starter,mp.is_captain,mp.raw_pitch_x,mp.raw_pitch_y,mp.coordinate_frame,
 mp.raw_position_code,mp.raw_position_code_state,mp.raw_position_code_source_number::text,
 mp.shirt_number,mp.shirt_number_state,mp.shirt_number_source_number::text,
 mp.played,mp.position_code,sides.team_public_id,sides.participant_label AS team_label,
 sr.external_key AS performance_id,aliases.public_id AS player_public_id,
 pp.id AS observed_profile_id,pp.image_asset_id,pp.external_profile_version_id,
 pp.display_name AS observed_name
 FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.period_definition_version='bootstrap_v1'
 AND s.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted
 JOIN football.match_players mp ON mp.revision_id=s.match_player_revision_id AND mp.match_id=s.match_id
 AND mp.team_id=s.team_id AND mp.player_id=s.player_id AND mp.source_id=s.source_id
 AND mp.source_record_id=s.source_record_id AND mp.variant_key=s.variant_key AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
 JOIN sides ON sides.match_id=mp.match_id AND sides.team_id=mp.team_id AND sides.revision_id=mp.match_team_revision_id
 LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=s.source_record_id AND sr.source_id=s.source_id AND sr.record_kind='performance'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='player' AND a.player_id=s.player_id AND a.public_key ~ '^p_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 LEFT JOIN football.player_profile_versions pp ON pp.id=mp.profile_version_id AND pp.player_id=mp.player_id
 AND NOT pp.is_deleted
), team_members AS (
 SELECT team_id,source_id FROM sides UNION
 SELECT ct.team_id,ct.source_id FROM x JOIN football.competition_teams ct ON ct.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 AND ct.competition_season_revision_id=x.edition_revision_id AND ct.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (ct.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<ct.recorded_to_gen) AND ct.is_canonical AND NOT ct.is_deleted
), team_candidates AS (
 SELECT p.*,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0 WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END priority
 FROM x JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id)
 AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL))
), team_profiles AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM team_candidates p WHERE p.priority=(SELECT min(c.priority) FROM team_candidates c WHERE c.team_id=p.team_id)
),
native_counts AS (
 SELECT p.revision_id,count(n.revision_id) AS states,
 coalesce(bool_or(n.value_kind='number' AND (n.numeric_value::text !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)([.][0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
 OR octet_length(n.numeric_value::text)>1024 OR abs(n.numeric_value)>1.7976931348623157e308::numeric
 OR (trunc(n.numeric_value)=n.numeric_value AND abs(n.numeric_value)>9007199254740991::numeric))),false) AS bad_number,
 coalesce(bool_or(CASE WHEN n.value_kind='number' THEN (CASE n.metric_code WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goals' THEN p.goals::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_assists' THEN p.assists::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shots' THEN p.shots::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget' THEN p.shots_on_target::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_chancesCreated' THEN p.chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated' THEN p.big_chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAccurate' THEN p.passes_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAttempted' THEN p.passes_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird' THEN p.passes_final_third::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_defensiveActions' THEN p.defensive_actions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_interceptions' THEN p.interceptions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_tackles' THEN p.tackles::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_recoveries' THEN p.recoveries::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsWon' THEN p.duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsLost' THEN p.duels_lost::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialsWon' THEN p.aerial_duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialDuels' THEN p.aerial_duels_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touches' THEN p.touches::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touchesBox' THEN p.touches_box::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_clearances' THEN p.clearances::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_blocks' THEN p.blocks::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribbles' THEN p.dribbles_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted' THEN p.dribbles_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_saves' THEN p.saves::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xg' THEN p.xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_npxg' THEN p.non_penalty_xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xa' THEN p.xa::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xgot' THEN p.xgot::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_minutes' THEN p.minutes_played::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_rating' THEN p.provider_rating::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented' THEN p.goals_prevented::text::numeric END) IS DISTINCT FROM n.numeric_value
 ELSE (CASE n.metric_code WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goals' THEN p.goals::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_assists' THEN p.assists::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shots' THEN p.shots::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget' THEN p.shots_on_target::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_chancesCreated' THEN p.chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated' THEN p.big_chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAccurate' THEN p.passes_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAttempted' THEN p.passes_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird' THEN p.passes_final_third::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_defensiveActions' THEN p.defensive_actions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_interceptions' THEN p.interceptions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_tackles' THEN p.tackles::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_recoveries' THEN p.recoveries::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsWon' THEN p.duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsLost' THEN p.duels_lost::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialsWon' THEN p.aerial_duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialDuels' THEN p.aerial_duels_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touches' THEN p.touches::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touchesBox' THEN p.touches_box::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_clearances' THEN p.clearances::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_blocks' THEN p.blocks::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribbles' THEN p.dribbles_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted' THEN p.dribbles_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_saves' THEN p.saves::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xg' THEN p.xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_npxg' THEN p.non_penalty_xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xa' THEN p.xa::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xgot' THEN p.xgot::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_minutes' THEN p.minutes_played::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_rating' THEN p.provider_rating::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented' THEN p.goals_prevented::text::numeric END) IS NOT NULL END) FILTER(WHERE n.revision_id IS NOT NULL),false) AS bad_projection
 FROM performances p LEFT JOIN football.player_match_metric_values n ON n.match_id=p.match_id AND n.player_id=p.player_id AND n.team_id=p.team_id
 AND n.match_player_revision_id=p.match_player_revision_id AND n.period_code=p.period_code
 AND n.period_definition_version=p.period_definition_version AND n.source_id=p.source_id
 AND n.source_record_id=p.source_record_id AND n.variant_key=p.variant_key AND n.family_code='standard'
 AND n.metric_definition_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND n.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND n.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31'
 AND n.transform_code_sha256=p.transform_code_sha256 AND n.metric_code IN ('legacy_normalized_goals','legacy_normalized_assists','legacy_normalized_shots','legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget','legacy_normalized_chancesCreated','legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated','legacy_normalized_passesAccurate','legacy_normalized_passesAttempted','legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird','legacy_normalized_defensiveActions','legacy_normalized_interceptions','legacy_normalized_tackles','legacy_normalized_recoveries','legacy_normalized_duelsWon','legacy_normalized_duelsLost','legacy_normalized_aerialsWon','legacy_normalized_aerialDuels','legacy_normalized_touches','legacy_normalized_touchesBox','legacy_normalized_clearances','legacy_normalized_blocks','legacy_normalized_dribbles','legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted','legacy_normalized_saves','legacy_normalized_xg','legacy_normalized_npxg','legacy_normalized_xa','legacy_normalized_xgot','legacy_normalized_minutes','legacy_normalized_rating','legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented') AND n.recorded_from_gen<=p.dg AND (n.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR p.dg<n.recorded_to_gen) AND n.is_canonical AND NOT n.is_deleted
 GROUP BY p.revision_id
), coverage AS (
 SELECT m.match_id,c.source_id,c.variant_key,c.observed_row_count,c.collection_state,c.coverage_state,c.is_stale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM performances p WHERE p.match_id=m.match_id) AS actual_count,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM performances p WHERE p.match_id=m.match_id AND (p.source_id<>c.source_id OR p.variant_key<>c.variant_key)) AS wrong_source
 FROM matches m LEFT JOIN ingest.match_coverage c ON c.match_id=m.match_id
 AND c.feature_code='normalized_performance' AND c.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (c.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<c.recorded_to_gen) AND c.is_canonical
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::text FROM matches) match_count,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted) selected_performance_count,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM matches WHERE public_id IS NULL) bad_match_alias,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM performances) performance_count,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT performance_id)::text FROM performances) unique_performance_count,

sql.sql:
/*orion:appearance:publicationmeta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.competition_season_revision_id::text edition_revision_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.id::text competition_id,co.name AS league_name,
 co.image_asset_id::text competition_asset_id,country.iso2 AS country,
 aliases.keys AS league_keys,totals.matches_count::text match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version LIMIT 1) publication ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id
 AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN football.countries country ON country.id=co.country_id AND country.revision_id=co.country_revision_id
 AND country.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (country.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<country.recorded_to_gen) AND country.is_canonical AND NOT country.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key COLLATE "C") keys
 FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=co.id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.id=$1::bigint AND b.status='ready' LIMIT 2

/*orion:appearance:admissionmeta*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS c(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,edition_revision_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,competition_id bigint)),
matches AS (
 SELECT s.*,x.dg,x.cg,aliases.public_id
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
 AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), sides AS (
 SELECT mt.*,m.dg,m.cg,aliases.public_id AS team_public_id FROM matches m
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=m.match_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=mt.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), performances AS (
 SELECT s.*,m.dg,m.cg,m.public_id AS match_public_id,m.match_date,
 mp.profile_version_id,mp.is_starter,mp.is_captain,mp.raw_pitch_x,mp.raw_pitch_y,mp.coordinate_frame,
 mp.raw_position_code,mp.raw_position_code_state,mp.raw_position_code_source_number::text,
 mp.shirt_number,mp.shirt_number_state,mp.shirt_number_source_number::text,
 mp.played,mp.position_code,sides.team_public_id,sides.participant_label AS team_label,
 sr.external_key AS performance_id,aliases.public_id AS player_public_id,
 pp.id AS observed_profile_id,pp.image_asset_id,pp.external_profile_version_id,
 pp.display_name AS observed_name
 FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.period_definition_version='bootstrap_v1'
 AND s.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted
 JOIN football.match_players mp ON mp.revision_id=s.match_player_revision_id AND mp.match_id=s.match_id
 AND mp.team_id=s.team_id AND mp.player_id=s.player_id AND mp.source_id=s.source_id
 AND mp.source_record_id=s.source_record_id AND mp.variant_key=s.variant_key AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
 JOIN sides ON sides.match_id=mp.match_id AND sides.team_id=mp.team_id AND sides.revision_id=mp.match_team_revision_id
 LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=s.source_record_id AND sr.source_id=s.source_id AND sr.record_kind='performance'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='player' AND a.player_id=s.player_id AND a.public_key ~ '^p_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 LEFT JOIN football.player_profile_versions pp ON pp.id=mp.profile_version_id AND pp.player_id=mp.player_id
 AND NOT pp.is_deleted
), team_members AS (
 SELECT team_id,source_id FROM sides UNION
 SELECT ct.team_id,ct.source_id FROM x JOIN football.competition_teams ct ON ct.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 AND ct.competition_season_revision_id=x.edition_revision_id AND ct.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (ct.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<ct.recorded_to_gen) AND ct.is_canonical AND NOT ct.is_deleted
), team_candidates AS (
 SELECT p.*,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0 WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END priority
 FROM x JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id)
 AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL))
), team_profiles AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM team_candidates p WHERE p.priority=(SELECT min(c.priority) FROM team_candidates c WHERE c.team_id=p.team_id)
),
native_counts AS (
 SELECT p.revision_id,count(n.revision_id) AS states,
 coalesce(bool_or(n.value_kind='number' AND (n.numeric_value::text !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)([.][0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
 OR octet_length(n.numeric_value::text)>1024 OR abs(n.numeric_value)>1.7976931348623157e308::numeric
 OR (trunc(n.numeric_value)=n.numeric_value AND abs(n.numeric_value)>9007199254740991::numeric))),false) AS bad_number,

 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=t.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 ORDER BY aliases.public_id COLLATE "C"

sql.sql:
/*orion:appearance:publicationmeta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.competition_season_revision_id::text edition_revision_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.id::text competition_id,co.name AS league_name,
 co.image_asset_id::text competition_asset_id,country.iso2 AS country,
 aliases.keys AS league_keys,totals.matches_count::text match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version LIMIT 1) publication ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id
 AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN football.countries country ON country.id=co.country_id AND country.revision_id=co.country_revision_id
 AND country.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (country.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<country.recorded_to_gen) AND country.is_canonical AND NOT country.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key COLLATE "C") keys
 FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=co.id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.id=$1::bigint AND b.status='ready' LIMIT 2

/*orion:appearance:admissionmeta*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS c(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,edition_revision_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,competition_id bigint)),
matches AS (
 SELECT s.*,x.dg,x.cg,aliases.public_id
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
 AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), sides AS (
 SELECT mt.*,m.dg,m.cg,aliases.public_id AS team_public_id FROM matches m
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=m.match_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=mt.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), performances AS (
 SELECT s.*,m.dg,m.cg,m.public_id AS match_public_id,m.match_date,
 mp.profile_version_id,mp.is_starter,mp.is_captain,mp.raw_pitch_x,mp.raw_pitch_y,mp.coordinate_frame,
 mp.raw_position_code,mp.raw_position_code_state,mp.raw_position_code_source_number::text,
 mp.shirt_number,mp.shirt_number_state,mp.shirt_number_source_number::text,
 mp.played,mp.position_code,sides.team_public_id,sides.participant_label AS team_label,
 sr.external_key AS performance_id,aliases.public_id AS player_public_id,
 pp.id AS observed_profile_id,pp.image_asset_id,pp.external_profile_version_id,
 pp.display_name AS observed_name
 FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.period_definition_version='bootstrap_v1'
 AND s.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted
 JOIN football.match_players mp ON mp.revision_id=s.match_player_revision_id AND mp.match_id=s.match_id
 AND mp.team_id=s.team_id AND mp.player_id=s.player_id AND mp.source_id=s.source_id
 AND mp.source_record_id=s.source_record_id AND mp.variant_key=s.variant_key AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
 JOIN sides ON sides.match_id=mp.match_id AND sides.team_id=mp.team_id AND sides.revision_id=mp.match_team_revision_id
 LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=s.source_record_id AND sr.source_id=s.source_id AND sr.record_kind='performance'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='player' AND a.player_id=s.player_id AND a.public_key ~ '^p_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 LEFT JOIN football.player_profile_versions pp ON pp.id=mp.profile_version_id AND pp.player_id=mp.player_id
 AND NOT pp.is_deleted
), team_members AS (
 SELECT team_id,source_id FROM sides UNION
 SELECT ct.team_id,ct.source_id FROM x JOIN football.competition_teams ct ON ct.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 AND ct.competition_season_revision_id=x.edition_revision_id AND ct.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (ct.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<ct.recorded_to_gen) AND ct.is_canonical AND NOT ct.is_deleted
), team_candidates AS (
 SELECT p.*,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0 WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END priority
 FROM x JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id)
 AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL))
), team_profiles AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM team_candidates p WHERE p.priority=(SELECT min(c.priority) FROM team_candidates c WHERE c.team_id=p.team_id)
),
native_counts AS (
 SELECT p.revision_id,count(n.revision_id) AS states,
 coalesce(bool_or(n.value_kind='number' AND (n.numeric_value::text !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)([.][0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
 OR octet_length(n.numeric_value::text)>1024 OR abs(n.numeric_value)>1.7976931348623157e308::numeric
 OR (trunc(n.numeric_value)=n.numeric_value AND abs(n.numeric_value)>9007199254740991::numeric))),false) AS bad_number,
 coalesce(bool_or(CASE WHEN n.value_kind='number' THEN (CASE n.metric_code WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goals' THEN p.goals::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_assists' THEN p.assists::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shots' THEN p.shots::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget' THEN p.shots_on_target::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_chancesCreated' THEN p.chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated' THEN p.big_chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAccurate' THEN p.passes_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAttempted' THEN p.passes_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird' THEN p.passes_final_third::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_defensiveActions' THEN p.defensive_actions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_interceptions' THEN p.interceptions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_tackles' THEN p.tackles::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_recoveries' THEN p.recoveries::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsWon' THEN p.duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsLost' THEN p.duels_lost::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialsWon' THEN p.aerial_duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialDuels' THEN p.aerial_duels_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touches' THEN p.touches::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touchesBox' THEN p.touches_box::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_clearances' THEN p.clearances::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_blocks' THEN p.blocks::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribbles' THEN p.dribbles_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted' THEN p.dribbles_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_saves' THEN p.saves::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xg' THEN p.xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_npxg' THEN p.non_penalty_xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xa' THEN p.xa::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xgot' THEN p.xgot::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_minutes' THEN p.minutes_played::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_rating' THEN p.provider_rating::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented' THEN p.goals_prevented::text::numeric END) IS DISTINCT FROM n.numeric_value
 ELSE (CASE n.metric_code WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goals' THEN p.goals::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_assists' THEN p.assists::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shots' THEN p.shots::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget' THEN p.shots_on_target::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_chancesCreated' THEN p.chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated' THEN p.big_chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAccurate' THEN p.passes_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAttempted' THEN p.passes_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird' THEN p.passes_final_third::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_defensiveActions' THEN p.defensive_actions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_interceptions' THEN p.interceptions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_tackles' THEN p.tackles::text::numeric WHEN /*orion:appearance:publicationmeta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.competition_season_revision_id::text edition_revision_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.id::text competition_id,co.name AS league_name,
 co.image_asset_id::text competition_asset_id,country.iso2 AS country,
 aliases.keys AS league_keys,totals.matches_count::text match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version LIMIT 1) publication ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id
 AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN football.countries country ON country.id=co.country_id AND country.revision_id=co.country_revision_id
 AND country.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (country.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<country.recorded_to_gen) AND country.is_canonical AND NOT country.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key COLLATE "C") keys
 FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=co.id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.id=$1::bigint AND b.status='ready' LIMIT 2

/*orion:appearance:admissionmeta*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS c(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,edition_revision_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,competition_id bigint)),
matches AS (
 SELECT s.*,x.dg,x.cg,aliases.public_id
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
 AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), sides AS (
 SELECT mt.*,m.dg,m.cg,aliases.public_id AS team_public_id FROM matches m
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=m.match_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=mt.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), performances AS (
 SELECT s.*,m.dg,m.cg,m.public_id AS match_public_id,m.match_date,
 mp.profile_version_id,mp.is_starter,mp.is_captain,mp.raw_pitch_x,mp.raw_pitch_y,mp.coordinate_frame,
 mp.raw_position_code,mp.raw_position_code_state,mp.raw_position_code_source_number::text,
 mp.shirt_number,mp.shirt_number_state,mp.shirt_number_source_number::text,
 mp.played,mp.position_code,sides.team_public_id,sides.participant_label AS team_label,
 sr.external_key AS performance_id,aliases.public_id AS player_public_id,
 pp.id AS observed_profile_id,pp.image_asset_id,pp.external_profile_version_id,
 pp.display_name AS observed_name
 FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.period_definition_version='bootstrap_v1'
 AND s.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted
 JOIN football.match_players mp ON mp.revision_id=s.match_player_revision_id AND mp.match_id=s.match_id
 AND mp.team_id=s.team_id AND mp.player_id=s.player_id AND mp.source_id=s.source_id
 AND mp.source_record_id=s.source_record_id AND mp.variant_key=s.variant_key AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
 JOIN sides ON sides.match_id=mp.match_id AND sides.team_id=mp.team_id AND sides.revision_id=mp.match_team_revision_id
 LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=s.source_record_id AND sr.source_id=s.source_id AND sr.record_kind='performance'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='player' AND a.player_id=s.player_id AND a.public_key ~ '^p_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 LEFT JOIN football.player_profile_versions pp ON pp.id=mp.profile_version_id AND pp.player_id=mp.player_id
 AND NOT pp.is_deleted
), team_members AS (
 SELECT team_id,source_id FROM sides UNION
 SELECT ct.team_id,ct.source_id FROM x JOIN football.competition_teams ct ON ct.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 AND ct.competition_season_revision_id=x.edition_revision_id AND ct.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (ct.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<ct.recorded_to_gen) AND ct.is_canonical AND NOT ct.is_deleted
), team_candidates AS (
 SELECT p.*,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0 WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END priority
 FROM x JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id)
 AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL))
), team_profiles AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM team_candidates p WHERE p.priority=(SELECT min(c.priority) FROM team_candidates c WHERE c.team_id=p.team_id)
),
native_counts AS (
 SELECT p.revision_id,count(n.revision_id) AS states,
 coalesce(bool_or(n.value_kind='number' AND (n.numeric_value::text !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)([.][0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
 OR octet_length(n.numeric_value::text)>1024 OR abs(n.numeric_value)>1.7976931348623157e308::numeric
 OR (trunc(n.numeric_value)=n.numeric_value AND abs(n.numeric_value)>9007199254740991::numeric))),false) AS bad_number,
 coalesce(bool_or(CASE WHEN n.value_kind='number' THEN (CASE n.metric_code WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goals' THEN p.goals::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_assists' THEN p.assists::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shots' THEN p.shots::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget' THEN p.shots_on_target::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_chancesCreated' THEN p.chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated' THEN p.big_chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAccurate' THEN p.passes_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAttempted' THEN p.passes_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird' THEN p.passes_final_third::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_defensiveActions' THEN p.defensive_actions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_interceptions' THEN p.interceptions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_tackles' THEN p.tackles::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_recoveries' THEN p.recoveries::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsWon' THEN p.duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsLost' THEN p.duels_lost::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialsWon' THEN p.aerial_duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialDuels' THEN p.aerial_duels_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touches' THEN p.touches::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touchesBox' THEN p.touches_box::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_clearances' THEN p.clearances::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_blocks' THEN p.blocks::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribbles' THEN p.dribbles_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted' THEN p.dribbles_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_saves' THEN p.saves::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xg' THEN p.xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_npxg' THEN p.non_penalty_xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xa' THEN p.xa::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xgot' THEN p.xgot::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_minutes' THEN p.minutes_played::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_rating' THEN p.provider_rating::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented' THEN p.goals_prevented::text::numeric END) IS DISTINCT /*orion:appearance:publicationmeta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.competition_season_revision_id::text edition_revision_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.id::text competition_id,co.name AS league_name,
 co.image_asset_id::text competition_asset_id,country.iso2 AS country,
 aliases.keys AS league_keys,totals.matches_count::text match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version LIMIT 1) publication ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id
 AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN football.countries country ON country.id=co.country_id AND country.revision_id=co.country_revision_id
 AND country.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (country.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<country.recorded_to_gen) AND country.is_canonical AND NOT country.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key COLLATE "C") keys
 FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=co.id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.id=$1::bigint AND b.status='ready' LIMIT 2

/*orion:appearance:admissionmeta*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS c(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,edition_revision_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,competition_id bigint)),
matches AS (
 SELECT s.*,x.dg,x.cg,aliases.public_id
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
 AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), sides AS (
 SELECT mt.*,m.dg,m.cg,aliases.public_id AS team_public_id FROM matches m
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=m.match_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=mt.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), performances AS (
 SELECT s.*,m.dg,m.cg,m.public_id AS match_public_id,m.match_date,
 mp.profile_version_id,mp.is_starter,mp.is_captain,mp.raw_pitch_x,mp.raw_pitch_y,mp.coordinate_frame,
 mp.raw_position_code,mp.raw_position_code_state,mp.raw_position_code_source_number::text,
 mp.shirt_number,mp.shirt_number_state,mp.shirt_number_source_number::text,
 mp.played,mp.position_code,sides.team_public_id,sides.participant_label AS team_label,
 sr.external_key AS performance_id,aliases.public_id AS player_public_id,
 pp.id AS observed_profile_id,pp.image_asset_id,pp.external_profile_version_id,
 pp.display_name AS observed_name
 FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.period_definition_version='bootstrap_v1'

 AND s.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted
 JOIN football.match_players mp ON mp.revision_id=s.match_player_revision_id AND mp.match_id=s.match_id
 AND mp.team_id=s.team_id AND mp.player_id=s.player_id AND mp.source_id=s.source_id
 AND mp.source_record_id=s.source_record_id AND mp.variant_key=s.variant_key AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
 JOIN sides ON sides.match_id=mp.match_id AND sides.team_id=mp.team_id AND sides.revision_id=mp.match_team_revision_id
 LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=s.source_record_id AND sr.source_id=s.source_id AND sr.record_kind='performance'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='player' AND a.player_id=s.player_id AND a.public_key ~ '^p_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 LEFT JOIN football.player_profile_versions pp ON pp.id=mp.profile_version_id AND pp.player_id=mp.player_id
 AND NOT pp.is_deleted
), team_members AS (
 SELECT team_id,source_id FROM sides UNION
 SELECT ct.team_id,ct.source_id FROM x JOIN football.competition_teams ct ON ct.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 AND ct.competition_season_revision_id=x.edition_revision_id AND ct.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (ct.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<ct.recorded_to_gen) AND ct.is_canonical AND NOT ct.is_deleted
), team_candidates AS (
 SELECT p.*,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0 WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END priority
 FROM x JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id)
 AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL))
), team_profiles AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM team_candidates p WHERE p.priority=(SELECT min(c.priority) FROM team_candidates c WHERE c.team_id=p.team_id)
)
 SELECT t.team_id::text,aliases.public_id AS id,p.id::text AS profile_id,p.display_name AS name,p.image_asset_id::text,
 p.country_code_source AS country,(SELECT count(DISTINCT s.match_id)::text FROM sides s WHERE s.team_id=t.team_id) sample_matches
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team_members) t CROSS JOIN x
 LEFT JOIN team_profiles p ON p.team_id=t.team_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=t.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 ORDER BY aliases.public_id COLLATE "C"

sql.sql:
/*orion:appearance:publicationmeta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.competition_season_revision_id::text edition_revision_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.id::text competition_id,co.name AS league_name,
 co.image_asset_id::text competition_asset_id,country.iso2 AS country,
 aliases.keys AS league_keys,totals.matches_count::text match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version LIMIT 1) publication ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id
 AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN football.countries country ON country.id=co.country_id AND country.revision_id=co.country_revision_id
 AND country.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (country.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<country.recorded_to_gen) AND country.is_canonical AND NOT country.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key COLLATE "C") keys
 FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=co.id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.id=$1::bigint AND b.status='ready' LIMIT 2

/*orion:appearance:admissionmeta*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS c(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,edition_revision_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,competition_id bigint)),
matches AS (
 SELECT s.*,x.dg,x.cg,aliases.public_id
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
 AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), sides AS (
 SELECT mt.*,m.dg,m.cg,aliases.public_id AS team_public_id FROM matches m
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=m.match_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=mt.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), performances AS (
 SELECT s.*,m.dg,m.cg,m.public_id AS match_public_id,m.match_date,
 mp.profile_version_id,mp.is_starter,mp.is_captain,mp.raw_pitch_x,mp.raw_pitch_y,mp.coordinate_frame,
 mp.raw_position_code,mp.raw_position_code_state,mp.raw_position_code_source_number::text,
 mp.shirt_number,mp.shirt_number_state,mp.shirt_number_source_number::text,
 mp.played,mp.position_code,sides.team_public_id,sides.participant_label AS team_label,
 sr.external_key AS performance_id,aliases.public_id AS player_public_id,
 pp.id AS observed_profile_id,pp.image_asset_id,pp.external_profile_version_id,
 pp.display_name AS observed_name
 FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.period_definition_version='bootstrap_v1'
 AND s.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted
 JOIN football.match_players mp ON mp.revision_id=s.match_player_revision_id AND mp.match_id=s.match_id
 AND mp.team_id=s.team_id AND mp.player_id=s.player_id AND mp.source_id=s.source_id
 AND mp.source_record_id=s.source_record_id AND mp.variant_key=s.variant_key AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
 JOIN sides ON sides.match_id=mp.match_id AND sides.team_id=mp.team_id AND sides.revision_id=mp.match_team_revision_id
 LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=s.source_record_id AND sr.source_id=s.source_id AND sr.record_kind='performance'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='player' AND a.player_id=s.player_id AND a.public_key ~ '^p_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 LEFT JOIN football.player_profile_versions pp ON pp.id=mp.profile_version_id AND pp.player_id=mp.player_id
 AND NOT pp.is_deleted
), team_members AS (
 SELECT team_id,source_id FROM sides UNION
 SELECT ct.team_id,ct.source_id FROM x JOIN football.competition_teams ct ON ct.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 AND ct.competition_season_revision_id=x.edition_revision_id AND ct.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (ct.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<ct.recorded_to_gen) AND ct.is_canonical AND NOT ct.is_deleted
), team_candidates AS (
 SELECT p.*,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0 WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END priority
 FROM x JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id)
 AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members t WHERE t.team_id=p.team_id AND t.source_id=p.source_id))
 OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL))
), team_profiles AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM team_candidates p WHERE p.priority=(SELECT min(c.priority) FROM team_candidates c WHERE c.team_id=p.team_id)
),
native_counts AS (
 SELECT p.revision_id,count(n.revision_id) AS states,
 coalesce(bool_or(n.value_kind='number' AND (n.numeric_value::text !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)([.][0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
 OR octet_length(n.numeric_value::text)>1024 OR abs(n.numeric_value)>1.7976931348623157e308::numeric
 OR (trunc(n.numeric_value)=n.numeric_value AND abs(n.numeric_value)>9007199254740991::numeric))),false) AS bad_number,
 coalesce(bool_or(CASE WHEN n.value_kind='number' THEN (CASE n.metric_code WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goals' THEN p.goals::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_assists' THEN p.assists::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shots' THEN p.shots::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget' THEN p.shots_on_target::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_chancesCreated' THEN p.chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated' THEN p.big_chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAccurate' THEN p.passes_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAttempted' THEN p.passes_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird' THEN p.passes_final_third::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_defensiveActions' THEN p.defensive_actions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_interceptions' THEN p.interceptions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_tackles' THEN p.tackles::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_recoveries' THEN p.recoveries::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsWon' THEN p.duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsLost' THEN p.duels_lost::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialsWon' THEN p.aerial_duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialDuels' THEN p.aerial_duels_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touches' THEN p.touches::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touchesBox' THEN p.touches_box::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_clearances' THEN p.clearances::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_blocks' THEN p.blocks::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribbles' THEN p.dribbles_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted' THEN p.dribbles_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_saves' THEN p.saves::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xg' THEN p.xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_npxg' THEN p.non_penalty_xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xa' THEN p.xa::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xgot' THEN p.xgot::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_minutes' THEN p.minutes_played::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_rating' THEN p.provider_rating::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented' THEN p.goals_prevented::text::numeric END) IS DISTINCT FROM n.numeric_value
 ELSE (CASE n.metric_code WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goals' THEN p.goals::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_assists' THEN p.assists::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shots' THEN p.shots::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget' THEN p.shots_on_target::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_chancesCreated' THEN p.chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated' THEN p.big_chances_created::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAccurate' THEN p.passes_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesAttempted' THEN p.passes_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird' THEN p.passes_final_third::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_defensiveActions' THEN p.defensive_actions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_interceptions' THEN p.interceptions::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_tackles' THEN p.tackles::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_recoveries' THEN p.recoveries::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsWon' THEN p.duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_duelsLost' THEN p.duels_lost::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialsWon' THEN p.aerial_duels_won::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_aerialDuels' THEN p.aerial_duels_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touches' THEN p.touches::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_touchesBox' THEN p.touches_box::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_clearances' THEN p.clearances::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_blocks' THEN p.blocks::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribbles' THEN p.dribbles_completed::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted' THEN p.dribbles_attempted::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_saves' THEN p.saves::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xg' THEN p.xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_npxg' THEN p.non_penalty_xg::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xa' THEN p.xa::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_xgot' THEN p.xgot::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_minutes' THEN p.minutes_played::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_rating' THEN p.provider_rating::text::numeric WHEN 'legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented' THEN p.goals_prevented::text::numeric END) IS NOT NULL END) FILTER(WHERE n.revision_id IS NOT NULL),false) AS bad_projection
 FROM performances p LEFT JOIN football.player_match_metric_values n ON n.match_id=p.match_id AND n.player_id=p.player_id AND n.team_id=p.team_id
 AND n.match_player_revision_id=p.match_player_revision_id AND n.period_code=p.period_code
 AND n.period_definition_version=p.period_definition_version AND n.source_id=p.source_id
 AND n.source_record_id=p.source_record_id AND n.variant_key=p.variant_key AND n.family_code='standard'
 AND n.metric_definition_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND n.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND n.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31'
 AND n.transform_code_sha256=p.transform_code_sha256 AND n.metric_code IN ('legacy_normalized_goals','legacy_normalized_assists','legacy_normalized_shots','legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget','legacy_normalized_chancesCreated','legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated','legacy_normalized_passesAccurate','legacy_normalized_passesAttempted','legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird','legacy_normalized_defensiveActions','legacy_normalized_interceptions','legacy_normalized_tackles','legacy_normalized_recoveries','legacy_normalized_duelsWon','legacy_normalized_duelsLost','legacy_normalized_aerialsWon','legacy_normalized_aerialDuels','legacy_normalized_touches','legacy_normalized_touchesBox','legacy_normalized_clearances','legacy_normalized_blocks','legacy_normalized_dribbles','legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted','legacy_normalized_saves','legacy_normalized_xg','legacy_normalized_npxg','legacy_normalized_xa','legacy_normalized_xgot','legacy_normalized_minutes','legacy_normalized_rating','legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented') AND n.recorded_from_gen<=p.dg AND (n.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR p.dg<n.recorded_to_gen) AND n.is_canonical AND NOT n.is_deleted
 GROUP BY p.revision_id
), coverage AS (
 SELECT m.match_id,c.source_id,c.variant_key,c.observed_row_count,c.collection_state,c.coverage_state,c.is_stale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM performances p WHERE p.match_id=m.match_id) AS actual_count,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM performances p WHERE p.match_id=m.match_id AND (p.source_id<>c.source_id OR p.variant_key<>c.variant_key)) AS wrong_source
 FROM matches m LEFT JOIN ingest.match_coverage c ON c.match_id=m.match_id
 AND c.feature_code='normalized_performance' AND c.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (c.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<c.recorded_to_gen) AND c.is_canonical
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::text FROM matches) match_count,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted) selected_performance_count,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM matches WHERE public_id IS NULL) bad_match_alias,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM performances) performance_count,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT performance_id)::text FROM performances) unique_performance_count,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM performances WHERE performance_id IS NULL OR performance_id='' OR player_public_id IS NULL
 OR team_public_id IS NULL OR (profile_version_id IS NOT NULL AND observed_profile_id IS NULL)) bad_identity,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM sides WHERE team_public_id IS NULL) bad_team_alias,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM native_counts WHERE states<>31) bad_native,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM native_counts WHERE bad_number) bad_number,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM native_counts WHERE bad_projection) bad_projection,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM coverage WHERE source_id IS NULL OR is_stale OR wrong_source
 OR coverage_state NOT IN ('available','empty_response')
 OR collection_state NOT IN ('present','empty') OR observed_row_count IS DISTINCT FROM actual_count
 OR (collection_state='empty' AND actual_count<>0) OR (collection_state='present' AND actual_count=0)) bad_coverage,
 (SELECT count(*)::text FROM (SELECT team_id FROM team_profiles GROUP BY team_id HAVING count(*)>1) ambiguous) bad_team_profile

/*orion:appearance:mediameta*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS c(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,edition_revision_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,competition_id bigint)),
matches AS (
 SELECT s.*,x.dg,x.cg,aliases.public_id
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
 AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), sides AS (
 SELECT mt.*,m.dg,m.cg,aliases.public_id AS team_public_id FROM matches m
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=m.match_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=mt.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), performances AS (
 SELECT s.*,m.dg,m.cg,m.public_id AS match_public_id,m.match_date,
 mp.profile_version_id,mp.is_starter,mp.is_captain,mp.raw_pitch_x,mp.raw_pitch_y,mp.coordinate_frame,
 mp.raw_position_code,mp.raw_position_code_state,mp.raw_position_code_source_number::text,
 mp.shirt_number,mp.shirt_number_state,mp.shirt_number_source_number::text,
 mp.played,mp.position_code,sides.team_public_id,sides.participant_label AS team_label,
 sr.external_key AS performance_id,aliases.public_id AS player_public_id,
 pp.id AS observed_profile_id,pp.image_asset_id,pp.external_profile_version_id,
 pp.display_name AS observed_name
 FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.period_definition_version='bootstrap_v1'
 AND s.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted
 JOIN football.match_players mp ON mp.revision_id=s.match_player_revision_id AND mp.match_id=s.match_id
 AND mp.team_id=s.team_id AND mp.player_id=s.player_id AND mp.source_id=s.source_id
 AND mp.source_record_id=s.source_record_id AND mp.variant_key=s.variant_key AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
 JOIN sides ON sides.match_id=mp.match_id AND sides.team_id=mp.team_id AND sides.revision_id=mp.match_team_revision_id
 LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records sr ON sr.id=s.source_record_id AND sr.source_id=s.source_id AND sr.record_kind='performance'
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='player' AND a.player_id=s.player_id AND a.public_key ~ '^p_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
 LEFT JOIN football.player_profile_versions pp ON pp.id=mp.profile_version_id AND pp.player_id=mp.player_id
 AND NOT pp.is_deleted
), team_members AS (

 AND n.transform_code_sha256=p.transform_code_sha256 AND n.metric_code IN ('legacy_normalized_goals','legacy_normalized_assists','legacy_normalized_shots','legacy_normalized_shotsOnTarget','legacy_normalized_chancesCreated','legacy_normalized_bigChancesCreated','legacy_normalized_passesAccurate','legacy_normalized_passesAttempted','legacy_normalized_passesFinalThird','legacy_normalized_defensiveActions','legacy_normalized_interceptions','legacy_normalized_tackles','legacy_normalized_recoveries','legacy_normalized_duelsWon','legacy_normalized_duelsLost','legacy_normalized_aerialsWon','legacy_normalized_aerialDuels','legacy_normalized_touches','legacy_normalized_touchesBox','legacy_normalized_clearances','legacy_normalized_blocks','legacy_normalized_dribbles','legacy_normalized_dribblesAttempted','legacy_normalized_saves','legacy_normalized_xg','legacy_normalized_npxg','legacy_normalized_xa','legacy_normalized_xgot','legacy_normalized_minutes','legacy_normalized_rating','legacy_normalized_goalsPrevented') AND n.recorded_from_gen<=p.dg AND (n.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR p.dg<n.recorded_to_gen) AND n.is_canonical AND NOT n.is_deleted

)
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::text FROM matches) match_count,

matches AS (

 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id
 AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted

 WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), sides AS (
 SELECT mt.*,m.dg,m.cg,aliases.public_id AS team_public_id FROM matches m
 JOIN football.match_teams mt ON mt.match_id=m.match_id AND mt.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mt.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mt.recorded_to_gen) AND mt.is_canonical AND NOT mt.is_deleted
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(a.public_key COLLATE "C") public_id FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='team' AND a.team_id=mt.team_id AND a.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=m.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
), performances AS (

 mp.profile_version_id,mp.is_starter,mp.is_captain,mp.raw_pitch_x,mp.raw_pitch_y,mp.coordinate_frame,
 mp.raw_position_code,mp.raw_position_code_state,mp.raw_position_code_source_number::text,
 mp.shirt_number,mp.shirt_number_state,mp.shirt_number_source_number::text,
 mp.played,mp.position_code,sides.team_public_id,sides.participant_label AS team_label,
 sr.external_key AS performance_id,aliases.public_id AS player_public_id,
 pp.id AS observed_profile_id,pp.image_asset_id,pp.external_profile_version_id,
 pp.display_name AS observed_name
 FROM matches m JOIN football.player_match_stats s ON s.match_id=m.match_id
 AND s.period_code='full_match' AND s.period_definition_version='bootstrap_v1'
 AND s.contract_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.transform_version='real_source_core_v2_native31' AND s.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<s.recorded_to_gen) AND s.is_canonical AND NOT s.is_deleted

 AND mp.team_id=s.team_id AND mp.player_id=s.player_id AND mp.source_id=s.source_id
 AND mp.source_record_id=s.source_record_id AND mp.variant_key=s.variant_key AND mp.recorded_from_gen<=m.dg AND (mp.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR m.dg<mp.recorded_to_gen) AND mp.is_canonical AND NOT mp.is_deleted
